# 24x7 AI

24x7 AI is a 24/7 AI phone assistant (AI receptionist / AI front desk) for small
businesses. It answers every call on the business's own phone number and through
an embeddable voice button on the business website. It answers routine questions
(hours, prices, services, orders, directions), books and reschedules appointments
to the business calendar, takes orders, captures lead details and callback
requests, and flags urgent calls. No press-1 phone menus, no hold music, no
missed calls after hours.

## Key facts

- Audience: local small businesses (dental practices, HVAC and home services,
  restaurants, plumbing, auto repair, veterinary clinics, salons, real estate,
  and other trades), US-focused.
- Pricing: monthly plans from $49/month, including up to 250 call minutes.
- Setup: concierge setup with the business; the business tests and approves
  before go-live; live in about 48 hours. No coding required.
- Integrations: business calendars (Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Cal.com),
  email, records/CRM (Google Sheets, HubSpot), the business's existing phone
  number, and website voice button. Custom integrations scoped during setup.
- Brand: "24x7 AI" is the brand mark; "24/7" is used in descriptive copy.
